quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.desc: Quotes saved in this browser. Reopen one to rerun the agents or adjust prices.
quotes.empty_hint: Quotes appear here after "Save" on the Prices step.

reference.title: Reference
reference.desc: The devices the tool can recognise, with every factory configuration checked against the manufacturer spec sheets.
reference.tradein_only: Monthly trade-in prices. Tablets are recognised in quotes; watches not yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Rules for the buy price. Changes apply immediately to open quotes.
settings.formula_text: Buy price = the price that leaves the target margin (as a % of the resale price) once refurbishing (category, grade), transport, private copy levy, customs, selling fees and the route's VAT are paid. Without a resale price: aligned on the median competitor buyback.
settings.refurb_desc: Parts, labour, logistics and data wiping, per grade. Starting values to adjust.
settings.grade_coef_desc: Coefficient applied to the catalog reference price (phones) when no agent finds a resale price.
settings.agents_desc: The agents call the price server (npm run server, VITE_PRICE_API_URL): buyback and resale sources for phones and laptops, robots.txt respected, one request per second per site, 6 h cache.
settings.server_down: Price server unreachable: run "npm run server" in the project folder.
settings.list_mode_mine: My selling price ("My prices" list) when there is one
settings.list_mode_prudent: Prudent: the lower of my price and the market
settings.list_mode_desc: The buy offer is computed from this resale price. Prudent mode protects the margin when the market has dropped below your list.
settings.aiMatching: Have the local AI check the lines
settings.aiMatching_desc: Every recognised line is reviewed by the local model (Nexus backend and Ollama), which picks the right reference model: it fills in unrecognised lines and fixes the rules' mistakes. A changed model still needs confirming.
settings.shareCorrections_desc: When moving on to prices, sends the Nexus backend what was recognised and what you corrected (without serial numbers or IMEIs), to measure and improve recognition.

prices.grid_hint: Type a price then Enter or Tab: it is saved at once. Clear a cell to delete the price. Greyed: the price a quote would use today (from "All" or another grade).
prices.tradein_hint: Reference: latest known trade-in price ({{month}}). Not saved to your prices.

route.title: Route and VAT
route.missing_lane: No transport rate for {{lanes}}: add it in Settings › Transport (counted as €0 meanwhile).
route.supplier_business_margin: A company under the margin scheme
route.eu_mix: EU marketplace (Back Market…), by the sales mix
route.rule_buy_consumer: Bought from consumers: no VAT to recover, resale possible under the margin scheme (VAT on the margin only).
route.rule_buy_business_margin: Supplier under the margin scheme: its invoice shows no VAT and must say so; you can resell under the margin scheme.
route.rule_buy_business_home: Bought from a French company with {{pct}} % VAT: VAT recoverable, resale under the standard scheme.
route.rule_buy_business_eu: Bought from a company in {{country}}: invoice net of VAT with both VAT numbers, VAT self-assessed in {{home}} (intra-EU acquisition). You are the importer of the devices.
route.rule_buy_import: Bought outside the EU ({{country}}): import VAT and customs clearance on arrival in {{home}}.
route.rule_warn_margin_not_allowed: Margin scheme not allowed: the lot was bought with recoverable VAT. Switch to the standard scheme, unless the supplier itself invoices under the margin scheme.
route.rule_warn_normal_costly: Standard scheme on a purchase with no VAT to recover: you pay VAT on the whole price. The margin scheme usually costs less.
route.rule_sell_marketplace: Marketplace: the buyer can be in any country where the listing is published. Costs follow the sales mix (Settings; {{home}}: {{homeShare}} %). You remain the seller: the marketplace doesn't collect VAT for an EU-established seller.
route.rule_sell_marketplace_b2b: Sale to businesses on a marketplace: countries spread by the Settings mix ({{home}}: {{homeShare}} %).
route.rule_vat_export: Export outside the EU ({{country}}): VAT-exempt sale, keep the proof of export.
route.rule_vat_none: No VAT: net prices, no VAT counted as your cost.
route.rule_vat_margin: {{country}} VAT {{pct}} % on the margin only, whatever the buyer's EU country; the invoice doesn't show VAT.
route.rule_vat_margin_b2b: Margin scheme in B2B too: invoice without visible VAT, {{country}} VAT {{pct}} % on the margin; your customer can't recover it.
route.rule_vat_b2b_home: Sale to a French company: net price, {{pct}} % VAT charged on top and paid over, neutral for you.
route.rule_vat_b2b_eu: Sale to a company in another EU country: VAT-exempt intra-EU supply, net invoice with its VAT number (check it on VIES) and the “reverse charge” mention.
route.rule_vat_oss_mix: VAT of each buyer's country (distance sales, OSS): {{pct}} % on average by the mix.
route.rule_vat_normal_home: VAT {{pct}} % on the whole sale price; the VAT paid on purchase is deducted.
route.rule_vat_oss: {{country}} VAT ({{pct}} %) on the whole price: distance sale declared through the OSS.
route.rule_levy_home: Private copy levy due in {{country}} on phones and tablets: monthly declaration to Copie France.
route.rule_levy_distance: {{country}} private copy levy, owed by the distance seller (CJEU, Opus, C-462/09); no Copie France on a delivery outside France.
route.rule_levy_mix: Private copy levy: Copie France on the share resold in {{home}} ({{homeShare}} %), the buyer's country levy for the rest.
route.rule_levy_b2b_home: Private copy levy due in {{home}} on the sale; a business customer keeping the devices for its own use can claim it back from Copie France.
route.rule_levy_b2b_eu: Outside France, no Copie France: the business buyer pays its country's levy on arrival.
route.rule_b2b_prices: B2B sale: resale price net of VAT, no marketplace commission. Check it is a wholesale price, not a retail price.

costs.title: Where the {{price}} go, per device
costs.note_vat_normal: Included in the resale price, paid to the State.
costs.note_vat_margin: Charged on our margin only (margin scheme).
costs.note_levy: Fixed amount per device, paid to Copie France.
costs.settings_desc: What it costs between purchase and resale depending on the countries: VAT, private copy levy, transport, customs and selling fees. Each quote picks its buying and resale country; these values are the defaults.
costs.vat_desc: Standard scheme: lot bought from a company with VAT, resold with the buyer country's VAT (OSS). Margin scheme: the shipping country's VAT on the margin only. Resale outside the EU: export, no VAT.
costs.ecoFee_desc: As per your contract with the compliance scheme. 0 if you don't pay it.
costs.countries: Countries, VAT and private copy levy
costs.countries_desc: Standard VAT rate and private copy levy due when a refurbished device is resold in the country. France: Copie France schedule for refurbished devices (decision no. 23), net of VAT; not due on exports or deliveries to another EU country. Laptops are not covered today.
costs.levy_desc: Brackets by storage capacity, the last one open-ended (∞). Unknown capacity: the highest bracket is counted.
costs.lanes_desc: Two ways to ship. As a parcel: a device sold to a consumer (Phone / Tablet / Laptop columns). As a lot: a purchase arriving at the centre ({{home}}) or a B2B sale, on a pallet or in a box (€ per device + per-shipment fee spread over the lot). A shop buyback only counts the per-device lot cost. “Estimate” rates are public averages from November 2026 for a business shipper: enter your real rates, they won't be replaced.
costs.simulator_desc: What a device costs from one country to another, excluding refurbishing.
costs.epr_country: WEEE / battery fee in this country (€ / device resold)
costs.market_mix_desc: Share of your marketplace sales by buyer country (Back Market: the countries your listings are published in). Used when a quote is resold on “EU marketplace”. Starting values are estimates: use your sales-by-country report.
costs.estimate_hint: Estimated default rate (November 2026). It follows updated estimates until you edit it.
costs.devices_per_pallet_desc: Used to count the pallets of a large lot (a mixed lot takes the room of each category). A small lot goes as parcels when cheaper than a pallet.

copie.title: Copie France declaration
copie.desc: Devices bought in the month and the private copy levy they owe if resold in France (refurbished schedule from Settings › Countries). The declaration is monthly, before the 20th of the following month.
copie.nothing: No device liable for the levy this month.
copie.caveat: Estimate based on buybacks: Copie France charges devices resold in France (stock releases). Devices resold abroad don't owe it; an unknown capacity is counted in the highest bracket.
copie.caveat_b2b: Lots moved to “Approved” during the month, saved in this browser. Estimate based on purchases: Copie France charges devices resold in France; a lot planned for resale elsewhere counts 0. Unknown capacity: highest bracket.
copie.note_resold_abroad: Resale planned outside France: not due
copie.note_eu_mix: EU marketplace: share resold in France by the mix

levy_note.FR: Copie France, decision no. 23 (refurbished), excl. VAT. Monthly declaration of stock leaving the warehouse before the 20th of the following month. PCs exempt.
levy_note.FI: No levy on devices: compensation paid by the State since 2015.
levy_note.BE: Auvibel, rate since 1 March 2026, excl. VAT. Reduced rate for refurbished devices (58-60 %?) unconfirmed: full rate to be safe.
levy_note.NL: Stichting de Thuiskopie, 2025 refurbished rate (60 % of new), excl. VAT. 2026 indexed, exact amount to check.
levy_note.DE: ZPÜ, amounts claimed (disputed) for consumer devices, also on imported second-hand ones. PCs: rate to check.
levy_note.AT: austro mechana, Gesamtvertrag 2025 (contract rate; 1.5 × without a contract). Due on a refurbished device put on the market in Austria for the first time. Quarterly declaration.
levy_note.ES: Levy on devices: amounts to check.
levy_note.PT: AGECOP levy by capacity: amounts to check.
levy_note.IT: SIAE: 128 GB smartphone ≈ €6.90, PC ≈ €5.20 before the 2025 decree (+16.8 %, refurbished included): check before filling in.
levy_note.SE: Copyswede, per-GB levy on phones: amount to check.
levy_note.EE: Levy as a % of the price: to check.
levy_note.GB: No private copying levy. Outside the EU: import VAT, customs clearance.
levy_note.CH: SUISA levy on storage: to check. Outside the EU: 8.1 % import VAT, customs clearance.
